summary: Requires data centers applying for air permits on or after July 1, 2026 to meet emissions limits at least as stringent as a stated standard, with DEQ guidance pointing toward Tier 4 controls.

source.citation: Data Center Knowledge, July 2026, on revised Virginia DEQ generator rules

notes: Associated DEQ guidance applies to permit applications submitted on or after July 1, 2026 and reflects a stated conclusion that hyperscale backup fleets no longer fit traditional emergency-only assumptions. Reported control technologies include selective catalytic reduction, diesel particulate filters, and continuous emissions monitoring systems.
